part_1_rung1_already_green.board_render_discrepancy_note: Issue #626 cites a board render (boardrun 20260710T010438Z, scripts/ember_totality/receipts-totality/ember-totality-20260710T011437Z.json) that shows C-GROW RED with reason text naming only 4 older non-satisfying candidate receipts, NOT the #618 measured-flops receipt. PR #618's own merge commit (0b2940ceae4992e7c3fb01b06cf1d23cbe14db92, git commit Date: Thu Jul 9 18:00:40 2026 -0700 = 2026-07-10T01:00:40Z) landed and, per its own commit message, was 'Verified before/after: RED with the receipt absent, GREEN with it present' -- i.e. the receipt satisfied full CHK at merge time. The cited board render ran at 2026-07-10T01:04:38Z, ~4 minutes after the merge commit's timestamp. `git log --follow` on the satisfying receipt's path shows exactly ONE commit (0b2940c) -- its content has never been modified since. The most likely explanation is a sync race between the totality board-runner's checkout and the merge landing (a known incident class in this repo per DG-W2b item (c): board-header timestamps have previously predated their own cited evidence). This is disclosed, not resolved here -- no probe or board-runner edits are in scope for this PR.
part_1_rung1_already_green.conclusion: C-GROW's GREEN status is carried entirely and legitimately by the pre-existing #618 receipt. This PR does not need to (and does not attempt to) flip C-GROW; it re-verifies the existing GREEN honestly and adds real-artifact-cited coverage of the next growth rung.
